description.en: The 5.5 × 2.1 mm DC barrel plug class: a barrel Ø5.5 mm outside and Ø2.1 mm inside, 9.5 mm from the tip to the collar, mating a 5.5 × 2.1 DC jack.
description.es: La clase de plug de barril DC de 5.5 × 2.1 mm: un barril de Ø5.5 mm por fuera y Ø2.1 mm por dentro, de 9.5 mm de la punta al collarín, que acopla con un jack DC de 5.5 × 2.1.
description.fr: La classe de fiche cylindrique CC 5,5 × 2,1 mm : un fût de Ø5,5 mm à l'extérieur et Ø2,1 mm à l'intérieur, à 9,5 mm de la pointe à la collerette, qui s'accouple à un jack CC 5,5 × 2,1.
description.pt: A classe de plugue de barril CC de 5,5 × 2,1 mm: um barril de Ø5,5 mm por fora e Ø2,1 mm por dentro, a 9,5 mm da ponta ao colar, que acopla num jack CC de 5,5 × 2,1.

sources.title: Same Sky PP3-002A DC power plug (rev 1.06) datasheet
sources.supports: barrel Ø5.5 ±0.05 outside, Ø2.1 ±0.05 inside, 9.5 ±0.3 from the tip to the collar

sources.title: Same Sky PJ-002A DC power jack (rev 1.10) datasheet
sources.supports: centre pin Ø2.0; mating plug Ø5.5; bore Ø6.50; jack insertion depth 9.5

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the collar's front face, on the barrel's axis. +z runs along the barrel to its tip at z = 9.5; the body and cable lie at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the barrel is round.

outside_diameter.note: the jack sheet's mating plug Ø5.5 (source 1)

barrel_length.note: tip to collar; the jack's insertion depth 9.5 (source 1)

interfaces.note: Male: the barrel goes into a 5.5 × 2.1 jack over its Ø2.0 pin; the collar seats on the jack's front face (the jack's 9.5 insertion depth equals the barrel's length).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: One maker's plug drawing, matched by its jack sheets. The 12 mm barrel option some makers sell is not covered.

envelope.note: The barrel only (its bore not subtracted); the body has no cited size.
